cookies.s1_p1: A cookie is a small text file placed on your device (computer, tablet, smartphone) when you visit a website. It allows the site to remember your actions and preferences, so you don't have to re-enter them on each visit.
cookies.s1_p2: Cookies are managed by your web browser and may contain information such as your session identifier, language preferences, or display settings.
cookies.s2_p1: These cookies are strictly necessary for the site to function. Without them, the requested services cannot be provided:
cookies.s2_li1: session_id — Keeps your user session active
cookies.s3_p1: These cookies collect information about how visitors use our platform (pages visited, time spent, errors). All data is aggregated and anonymized, without allowing you to be personally identified.
cookies.s4_p1: These cookies remember choices you have made on the platform:
cookies.s5_p1: These cookies, placed by our advertising partners, build a profile of your interests to show you relevant ads on other sites. They rely on uniquely identifying your browser and device.
cookies.s6_p1: In addition to cookies, we use web beacons, tracking pixels, and local storage (localStorage) to improve your experience. These technologies work similarly to cookies.
cookies.s7_li1: Ensure proper functioning and security of your account
cookies.s7_li2: Remember your preferences and personalized settings
cookies.s7_li3: Analyze platform usage and improve our services
cookies.s7_li4: Provide content tailored to your interests
cookies.s7_li5: Measure the effectiveness of our communications
cookies.s8_p1: You can control and manage cookies in several ways:
cookies.s8_li1: Browser settings — Most browsers allow you to refuse or accept cookies and delete existing ones.
cookies.s8_li2: Platform settings — Manage your cookie preferences directly from your eBetStream account settings.
cookies.s8_li3: Third-party tools — Extensions like Ghostery or Privacy Badger can block certain tracking cookies.
cookies.s8_note: Disabling certain cookies may affect platform functionality and reduce the quality of your experience.
cookies.s9_p1: Some cookies are placed by third-party services on our pages (social networks, video players, analytics tools). We have no control over these cookies and recommend consulting those services' policies.
cookies.s10_li1: Session cookies — Automatically deleted when you close your browser
cookies.s10_li2: Persistent cookies — Stored for a set period (30 days to 2 years) or until manually deleted
cookies.s11_p1: Our use of cookies complies with GDPR and the ePrivacy Directive. We collect your consent before placing non-essential cookies. For more information, see our
cookies.s12_p1: We reserve the right to modify this policy at any time to comply with regulations or reflect our practices. Any changes will be posted on this page with the update date.
cookies.s13_p1: For any questions about our use of cookies, contact us at:
